what: exit policy for effort=auto: (a) the cascade selection picks the cascade family and the per-exit temperatures; (b) per-exit thresholds

a_cascade.script: scripts/select_exit_policy.py policy (rsijev/exit_policy.py select_cascade); the evaluation sets are read once

policy_dev_v1.text_sources: held-out non-test proxies: an MMLU-Pro-style knowledge proxy (798 q), hard multiple choice, CRUXEval / POP909 / chess / home-simulator Decision Index dev rows, HoVer / RAGTruth / iSarcasm / ESCI / Habermas / When2Call dev rows, hallucination and intent probes, held score (1,501 q) and no-unknown (1,000 q) rows of the lineage corpora, plus the checkpoint's own DEV dump
policy_dev_v1.vision_sources: held rows of the 30 image sources of the image-stage corpus; eval_vision_v1 images excluded
policy_dev_v1.exclusions: trained rows of every lineage corpus, label clashes, exact evaluation states, items matching the evaluation set at >= .97
policy_dev_v1.halves: sha256('policy3-half:' + case_id) % 2 (0 -> A fit, 1 -> B select)

families.C_t: cascade 12/16/20 then 32 at one tau, t = .51 .. .99

selection.feasible: ECE_TXT <= .07 and TXT, KN, VIS each >= always-32 - .010

b_thresholds.script: scripts/select_exit_policy.py thresholds (rsijev/exit_policy.py Thresholds): A selects, B confirms; then thresholds --eval (one evaluation read)
b_thresholds.policy: stop at 16 if conf16 >= tau16, else at 20 if conf20 >= tau20, else 32; images always 32; conf = T-scaled max probability

dev_sets.suite_like: policy development set v1 (as in a)
dev_sets.held_out: policy development set v2 (8,890 q) + its fill (2,788 q)
dev_sets.shift_matched: v2 + fill minus their home-simulator and API-Bank rows, plus Home simulator rendered by the Decision Index kit (1,358 q) and API-Bank train rendered with the kit's catalog (702 q)

b_thresholds.objective: max shift-matched DI-metric U; ties within .002 -> lower depth, then lower tau16, tau20
b_thresholds.confirmation: A-winner satisfies C1-C3 on B and its B shift-matched U > C16_t0.59's
b_thresholds.where_it_lives: meta.json adaptive.auto_thresholds of the published package, read by serve/release.py auto_thresholds(); adaptive.tau 0.59 stays the single-number default
b_thresholds.benchmark_weights: each Decision Index benchmark's share of the index per unit of skill at exit 32, from a per-benchmark diagnostic of the checkpoint (exit_policy.bench_weights); chance skill from the kit's index file
